What does this have to do with MGTOW? Well, probably 90% of the threads here could be summarized as "here's a reason to go MGTOW" - it's like we're constantly having to reassure ourselves that we've made the right choice. "Women can be pretty awful - news at 11."

Once in a while, we need to discuss what comes next. After you go MGTOW, how should you live your life?

Modern life in western democracies, is pretty good. By the standards of previous generations, we're all living like kings. We've got great food from all over the world, we've got more kinds of beer than we could drink in a lifetime, we've got unlimited amusements like video games, etc. But this is all basically hedonism, isn't it? I submit to you that those things will give you pleasure, but not happiness. Eventually, you will start to feel that something is missing.

So watch the linked video and consider the following: there is something innate in men that makes us seek challenges. We want to be tested by nature and by other men - it's how we come to know ourselves. We long to "spend ourselves in a worthy cause" as Teddy Roosevelt said, so that "[our] place shall never be with those cold and timid souls who neither know victory nor defeat."

I suspect that men will find those words, and the video, stirring in a way that women will not understand. Do you feel what I'm describing? Well, this is who you are. Embrace it as your nature as a man. And consider that the "W" in MGTOW should take this nature into account.

It doesn't have to be quite as extreme as the guy in the video (and let's face it, if those ships even still existed, they'd be totally sanitized in order to accommodate women), but there are other things you can do. To it's great credit, the manosphere is big on exercise. I think that's a great modern avenue to this kind of fulfillment. What else can you suggest?
